failureMessage: the vendored canon is refreshed nightly and refactored upstream — code that reaches into it inherits every canon rename as a breaking change
fix: inline the few lines you need into your own tree, remove the reference, or accept it with a reason in .claudinite-settings.json (rule "claudinite-isolation")

forbidReferences.reason: consumer files must not couple to the vendored canon — the wiring files are the reviewed exceptions (vendoring/DESIGN.md)

failureMessage: the scheduler is the repo's only cron and its anchor arithmetic runs on the hour — a drifted cron or a missing guard silently breaks staggering, double-run safety, or manual runs

countMatchingLines.what: declares {count} cron schedules, expected exactly one
countMatchingLines.fix: keep a single cron — the scheduler is the repo's only one, and its two daily ticks are two hours in ONE expression, never two schedule entries

matchLines.what: {match} is not two daily ticks (or the legacy hourly form) on a fixed minute in :10–:50
matchLines.fix: use "<minute> <dailyHour>,<dailyHour+12> * * *", minute 10 to 50, all written by the converge; the legacy "<minute> * * * *" still passes until this repo's workflow pull request lands

checkEachFile.fix: add workflow_dispatch: so the scheduler can be run manually
add a concurrency: group so overlapping runs serialize (double-run safety)

checkEachFile.what: does not run the vendored engine entry
checkEachFile.fix: run the vendored engine entry — node .claudinite/shared/engine/scheduler/queue/scheduler-run.mjs, or the retired `tick.mjs` beside it until this repo's workflow pull request lands
set permissions.contents: write — the update runner pushes its delivery branch; without it the self-refresh 403s
set permissions.pull-requests: write — the update runner opens its PR and arms auto-merge; without it the PR create 403s

failureMessage: claudinite-lifecycle carries Claudinite's own rules — the mount, the declaration, adoption, the update and the task contract — a member that does not declare it runs the machinery with none of them

checkParsedFiles.what: does not declare the mandatory "claudinite-lifecycle" pack
checkParsedFiles.fix: add "claudinite-lifecycle" to "packs" — it is basics' own dependency, so the requires closure writes it back the next time the declaration is written
